items.headline: NextTrip earnings missed by $0.11, revenue fell short of estimates By Investing.com
items.summary: Investing.com - NextTrip (NASDAQ: NTRP) reported third quarter EPS of $-0.2500, $0.11 worse than the analyst estimate of $-0.1450. Revenue for the quarter came in at $546.69K versus the consensus estimate of $1.74M.
